# Wikipedia

> > The free online encyclopedia that anyone can edit, covering millions of topics from history and science to culture and current events.

Wikipedia is a collaborative, multilingual encyclopedia project operated by the Wikimedia Foundation. Founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, it has become the world's largest reference website, written and maintained by volunteer editors (Wikipedians) worldwide.

- Wikimedia Foundation
- Jimmy Wales
